messages:
incident-bot: Pager: hosted-runtime gpupool-5 - kvcache memory spike detected. Multiple OOMs and evictions, severity: high. Alert group: kvcache.continuous_batching.memory.
anya_oncall: ack - I'm oncall. Pulling logs and traces now.
jamal: saw the alerts, correlating with last deployment. Pulling deploy history.
deploy-bot: Deployed commit abcdef1 (marsh-batching): changed continuous_batching.batch_window from 16 -> 64 at 2024-11-07T02:14:12Z
marie_sre: customer-impact? which endpoints?
eli_prod: CS reports spike of 502s on /api/v1/chat/generate and increased latency for embeddings. Small subset of hosted customers hit rate limits.
anya_oncall: heap profiles show runaway KV growth for sessions with long prompt tails (>120k tokens). Prefetch depth multiplied due to batch_window increase and prefix amplification.
jamal: hypothesis: the batch_window increase caused more aggressive prefetch merging -> larger KV windows and less eviction. Long prompts from customer X amplified.
marie_sre: any easy mitigation to reduce memory pressure without full rollback?
anya_oncall: proposing a quick 'thermostat' throttle: cap prefetch depth and set per-session kv window cap to 32k tokens. We can push a hotpatch to runtime config.
eli_prod: good. CS to affected customers to notify potential degraded throughput.
cs-bot: Notifying account teams for affected orgs: org-1781, org-8832. Suggested message drafted.
jamal: prepping hotpatch. Patch will: 
```
- continuous_batching.batch_window -> 24
- kvcache.prefetch_max_depth -> 8
- kvcache.session_kv_token_cap -> 32000
- enable aggressive short-prefix-eviction = true
```
anya_oncall: will route low-tier requests to cheaper model variants and enforce small-batch fallback for sessions > 80k tokens.
deploy-bot: Starting hotpatch rollout (canary on gpupool-5/slot-a) commit hotfix/thermostat-2024-11-07
jamal: canary looks stable for 3 minutes, memory per-pod down ~40%. Rolling to remaining gpupool-5 nodes.
marie_sre: coordinating on-call handoff: I'm taking day shift in 30m, will own customer comms and follow-up.
anya_oncall: handing off incident to @marie_sre in 30m, will stay on thread until then.
eli_prod: CS update: throttling will likely increase latency for some long-prompt workloads; customers affected are being notified, offering rollback-free credits.
marie_sre: thanks. Post-hotpatch checks: 1) OOM rate should drop to near zero, 2) 95th latency for /chat should return to baseline within 15 minutes, 3) no new 5xx spikes.
jamal: adding temporary metric alert: kvcache.memory.total > 80% for gpupool-5 -> page.
incident-bot: Acknowledged: alert updated.
anya_oncall: confirming no data loss, ops evictions were soft - sessions restarted gracefully.
marie_sre: handoff complete - I'm now primary. Please add any follow-ups.
jamal: follow-up items: longer-term: re-evaluate default batch_window, add prefetched-kv accounting per-customer, and add regression test for long-prompt amplification.
eli_prod: opening a postmortem ticket and tagging product/infra.
cs-bot: Sent customer comms to org-1781 and org-8832; holding for follow-up.
marie_sre: incident status -> mitigated. Monitoring for 2 hours. Will update postmortem with timeline and root cause. :white_check_mark:
